# What’s new in OverCue Desktop 2.0.4

- App update only. CDJ-3000 player firmware is unchanged; no player update is needed for this release.
- Adds “Create USB manually” in Firmware, with separate installer and uninstaller downloads that open in your browser.
- Shows manual copying instructions after automatic USB preparation fails, including the required CDJ3Kv000.UPD filename.
- Keeps manual downloads available when the app cannot detect or access your USB.
